steps: Open an MSUFCU checking account with a Visa Debit Card between June 1, 2026 and October 31, 2026 as a current MSU student enrolled in the 2026-2027 academic year.
Make at least 10 qualifying debit card purchase transactions (point-of-sale with physical card or digital wallet; no ATM/transfers/P2P) within 30 days of account opening.
Receive $50 into your Spartan Saver account within 4 weeks of the qualifying 10th transaction.
